remarks: Riverfront living at The Landings, an award winning mid rise condominium overlooking the Norwalk River. This well appointed 2 bedroom, 2 full and 1 half bath ranch-style unit offers hardwood floors, crown molding, gas fireplace, and a private balcony with scenic water views. The kitchen features granite countertops, mahogany cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and newly installed stove/oven and microwave. The spacious primary suite includes a walk-in closet with custom shelving and a spa-like bath with double sinks, separate shower, and soaking tub. A second en-suite bedroom, powder room, and separate laundry room with new washer and dryer complete the layout. Elevator building, garage, storage unit with intercom access and riverfront walkway. Conveniently located to Metro-North and minutes to I-95, Route 7, shopping, restaurants, and Stew Leonard's! Unit may be sold furnished for a turnkey option.
